shots.description: 163 km/h five-star reserve escape after the storm. Falcon searchlight, six police cars, burning barricade, citizens against police, wet neon and readable crew comms.
Shotgun cover battle in a crowded blossom market during light showers; shoppers, vendors, police pursuit, mission timer and dispatch.
